items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, she came to work out there. In my band.

ctx.x: I think, Mr. Howard, you mentioned that Miss Hightower worked in your band at some point? Is that what you said a few minutes ago?
Yeah, she came to work out there. In my band. I played--she didn't play many, not pieces, you know.
